prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, data maturity, and whether you need creative, media buying, personalization, or AI product/engineering work.

If you want a quick starting list (well-known LA/global agencies with strong AI/data capabilities):
- R/GA (LA) — known for product innovation, data-driven creative and AI-powered experiences.
- VaynerMedia — strong social, influencer and performance marketing backed by data tools.
- Ogilvy (LA) — large full-service capability with data and personalization services.
- Publicis Sapient / Isobar (Dentsu/Publicis group teams in LA) — experience transformation, commerce and analytics-led AI work.
- Boutique/specialist firms and platforms to consider depending on need: smaller LA shops that focus on AI-driven performance or creative personalization, and category platforms like Persado (AI language optimization) or Pattern89/Shutterstock tools for ad creative — these are often used by agencies rather than replacing them.

How to choose the best one for you
- Goal: brand awareness, direct response, personalization, AI product development, or analytics/attribution?
- Industry fit and examples/case studies in your vertical
- Budget and contract type (retainer, project, revenue share)
- Channels (social, search, programmatic, email, on-site personalization)
- Data readiness: do you have first-party data, CDP, analytics in place?
- Evidence: ask for KPIs, case studies, references and which AI tools they built vs. licensed

If you want, tell me:
- Your business type and industry
- Primary marketing goal and channels
- Monthly budget (or range)
- Timeline and whether you need creative/tech/analytics

I’ll shortlist 2–3 LA agencies (or 1 enterprise + 1 boutique) and give suggested interview questions and an email/RFP template to reach them. Which would you prefer?
